wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitleClient: Track what you’ve paid out to workers through Isoko Talents.
wallet.subtitleWorker: Track what you’ve earned through Isoko Talents.
wallet.simulatedNotice: Isoko Talents uses a simulated MTN Mobile Money integration for this demo — no real money moves.
wallet.noTransactions: No transactions yet — complete a match to see it here.
wallet.workerStep1Body: Apply to an open gig and get approved by an admin, so a match is created for you.
wallet.workerStep2Body: When you accept, the client pays into escrow. You can see it is secured before you start.
wallet.workerStep3Body: When you finish, the client gives you a 4-digit code. Enter it and the money is yours.
wallet.clientStep1Body: Describe the job and set a budget. An admin reviews it before it goes live to workers.
wallet.clientStep2Body: When a worker accepts, pay with MoMo. Isoko holds the money until the job is done.
wallet.clientStep3Body: When you are happy with the work, give the worker your completion code. That releases the payment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your public profile, location visibility, and account data.
settings.profileDescWorker: Your bio and location appear on your public profile, which clients can see.
settings.profileDescOther: Your bio appears on your public profile, which other users can see.
settings.securityDesc: Change your password using the same link-based reset flow you'd use if you forgot it.
settings.exportDesc: Download a copy of everything Isoko Talents holds about your account — your profile, skill submissions, gigs, matches, payments, reviews, and messages — as a JSON file.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: In-app notifications are always on. Choose one more way to hear from us.
notifications.inAppAlways: You will always see notifications here, whichever option you pick.
notifications.emailHint: For payments, account changes and decisions on your work.
notifications.smsHint: For payments, account changes and decisions on your work, by text message.
notifications.smsPhoneInvalid: Enter a Rwandan mobile number starting 072, 073, 078 or 079.
notifications.smsCodeWrong: That code is not right. {{count}} tries left.
notifications.smsCodeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
notifications.smsSendFailed: Could not send the code. Try again shortly.
notifications.smsConsent: By confirming, you agree that Isoko sends notifications to this number through Pindo, an SMS provider in Rwanda. You can switch SMS off here at any time.
notifications.smsSender: During the pilot, texts arrive from “{{sender}}” and start with “Isoko:”.
notifications.verifyPending: No email will be sent until you confirm this address.
notifications.verifySent: Check your inbox for a confirmation link.
notifications.verifyFailed: Could not send the link. Try again shortly.
notifications.saveFailed: Could not save that. Try again.

passport.title: Skill passport
passport.explainer: A link and QR code that prove your verified skills to anyone, even people not on Isoko. Show it to a client and they can check it on the spot.
passport.shareNote: Anyone with this link can see your verified skills and job history. Revoke it any time.
passport.verifiedNow: Verified: these details match the record right now.
passport.recordChanged: This record has changed since the passport was created. The current details are shown below.
passport.footer: Verified skills were each approved by reviewers assigned automatically, who cannot be chosen by the worker. Reviewers are not named, to keep them independent.
passport.invalidHelp: Ask the worker for a current link.

invalid.unknownPassport: This passport could not be found.
invalid.invalidSignature: This link is not a valid passport.
invalid.revoked: This passport has been revoked by its holder.
invalid.unknownHolder: The holder of this passport no longer has an account.

income.title: Income statement
income.explainer: A signed record of what you have actually been paid through Isoko. Lenders and mobile-money providers can check it, which cash work cannot prove.

experience.summaryPlaceholder: For example: five years repairing phones in Nyamirambo, mostly screens and charging ports.

credentials.title: Proof of skill

tierHelp.self_declared: The worker told us they do this. Nobody has checked it yet.
tierHelp.document_sighted: A reviewer looked at a certificate the worker provided. That confirms the document was seen — it is not a check of whether the award itself is genuine.
tierHelp.peer_reviewed: Independent reviewers examined evidence of the work and approved it. The reviewers are assigned automatically and cannot be chosen by the worker.
tierHelp.work_earned: Built from jobs completed and reviewed on Isoko.

credentials.addHint: Photograph a paper certificate or upload a PDF. A reviewer will confirm they have seen it. We cannot verify the award itself.
credentials.certTitlePlaceholder: For example: TVET Level 3 in Electronics
credentials.declareHint: Tell clients what you do. You can add proof later — a skill with no proof still shows, marked as self-declared.
credentials.honestNotice: Isoko confirms a reviewer saw your certificate. It does not confirm the certificate is genuine, and it never claims to.

escrow.codeHint: Give this code to the worker when the job is done. Entering it releases the payment.
escrow.releaseConfirmBody: The money goes to {{name}} and the job is marked complete. This cannot be undone.
escrow.enterCodeLabel: Enter the client's code to finish the job
escrow.wrongCode: That code isn't right. {{count}} tries left.

escrow.workDoneClient: The worker reported this job done. It releases automatically on {{date}} unless you release it sooner.

receipt.notFoundHelp: Check the number on the printed receipt. Receipts exist only for money released to a worker.
